author: jumpingpea
body:
Username: jumpingpea
What happened: I was just temp-ban until Wednesday, June 10 by Petlas. I was temp-banned for spawnblocking. The only problem is, I was not spawnblock. I was nowhere near the spawn. One second I was placing wood and logs around the monument to help protect it, and the next second I was banned. 

Why I should be unbanned: I didn't do anything wrong, unless you consider surrounding the monument in blocks against the rules.

title: jumpingpea's temp-ban appeal

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

Unfortunately I have decided to deny your appeal.

I'm sure that the Mod did what was needed. Small temp-bans like this are hard to appeal without evidence. I suggest just waiting it out. It's only 3 days.

If you are unsure about the rules i'll leave a link here to them. Please try not to break anymore rules as it could lead up to a longer Temp-ban and or Perm Ban.

Regards, 
Dylan.
